description: This file contains implementations of Azure Cognitive Services Text-to-Speech (TTS) services, including a base mixin class, streaming and non-streaming service classes, and utility functions for SSML construction and sample rate conversion. It manages Azure SDK interactions, event handling, and speech synthesis workflows.

classes.name: AzureBaseTTSService
classes.description: A mixin class providing common Azure TTS functionalities such as SSML construction, voice configuration, and parameter management.

classes.name: AzureTTSService
classes.description: A streaming Azure TTS service with word timestamping, supporting real-time synthesis and word boundary handling.

classes.name: AzureHttpTTSService
classes.description: A non-streaming Azure TTS service using HTTP API for simpler text-to-speech synthesis.

methods.name: sample_rate_to_output_format
methods.description: Converts a sample rate in Hz to the corresponding Azure SpeechSynthesisOutputFormat enum value, defaulting to Raw24Khz16BitMonoPcm.

methods.name: _init_azure_base
methods.description: Initializes Azure-specific configuration including API key, region, voice, and parameters.

methods.name: _construct_ssml
methods.description: Constructs SSML string with proper escaping and optional styling based on parameters.

methods.name: _escape_text
methods.description: Escapes special characters in text for SSML compliance.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes speech synthesizer and configures Azure SDK for TTS.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Performs text-to-speech synthesis, yielding audio frames, handling streaming or non-streaming as per class.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the streaming TTS service and cleans up resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing synthesis and resets state.

methods.name: _is_cjk_language
methods.description: Checks if the current language setting is a CJK language.

methods.name: _is_punctuation_only
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only punctuation and whitespace.

methods.name: _handle_word_boundary
methods.description: Handles word boundary events from Azure SDK, routing to language-specific handlers.

methods.name: _emit_pending_word
methods.description: Emits the currently buffered word if any.

methods.name: _handle_cjk_word_boundary
methods.description: Handles word boundary logic for CJK languages, merging characters and emitting at natural break points.

methods.name: _handle_non_cjk_word_boundary
methods.description: Handles word boundary logic for non-CJK languages, emitting words after punctuation merging.

methods.name: _word_processor_task_handler
methods.description: Processes queued word timestamps and updates word timing data.

methods.name: _handle_synthesizing
methods.description: Handles incoming audio chunks during synthesis.

methods.name: _handle_completed
methods.description: Handles completion event, updating cumulative audio duration.

methods.name: _handle_canceled
methods.description: Handles cancellation events, logging reasons.

methods.name: _reset_state
methods.description: Resets internal state between TTS sessions.

methods.name: flush_audio
methods.description: Placeholder to flush any buffered audio data.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption by stopping synthesis and resetting state.
